messages:
elen: quick follow-up from the pinning schema sync. we need to reconcile three constraints: 1) minimal hot-path payload for throughput, 2) admin/controlplane full fidelity, 3) safe client/server compatibility rules.

noah: agree. i'm worried about ambiguity in short keys if we go too compact. suggest one-letter wire keys but require `sv` and server-side expansion for logs.

tess: +1. also propose a tiny contract for defaults so older runtimes don't break: default pin type = soft, missing lease = indefinite, unknown keys ignored.

elen: sketch for wire (hot path): `p`=pin kind (hard|soft), `k`=scope (model|variant|tenant), `v`=version id, `e`=expiry RFC3339, `o`=origin, `s`=schema_version. example: ```{"p":"hard","k":"model","v":"m-3b2f","e":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z","o":"rolloutsvc:42","s":3}```

noah: admin flows (control plane) accept expanded JSON with `overrides`, `reason`, `requester` fields. we intentionally keep overrides out of the hot RPC shape to avoid extra copying and size.

tess: telemetry/compliance: add `obs` wire field to map small observer ids. control plane will translate `obs` to readable names for audit logs.

devops-bot: created ticket PIN-452 for compatibility test harness and PIN-453 for runtime parsers.

elen: runtime libs should accept both compact and expanded; they must canonicalize into expanded objects internally. provide Go + Python + Node helpers.

noah: compatibility rule: servers must ignore unknown fields. clients MUST tolerate missing fields, using defaults. when `s` >= 3, server may reject unknown critical flags (documented).

tess: console/UI promise: always display expanded keys, never raw single-letter keys. add a mapping table in docs.

elen: decision summary: adopt compact single-character wire schema for hot RPCs, control-plane keeps expanded admin schema, require schema_version (`s`) on new features, provide parsing libs and Console expansion. action items: noah -> draft RFC + compat matrix; tess -> UX mapping + audit hooks; elen -> PR for serializer and migration notes.

noah: will put up RFC by end of week (WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/10101).

tess: will mock Console expand in next sprint and loop in security for audit retention.

elen: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
